seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Parse 21x21 3x3 blocks from frame colours: axis row = most ring-10 blocks (centre 0 = selected), any 11 = solid target, ring 5 pieces split by growing from 0 centres through non-9 centres.
A1/A2 move selection one block row (axis unblocked; pieces blocked by board edge/other pieces), A3/A4 move pieces only, A5 axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Render layers piece>reflection(2A-r, skip piece cells/on-axis)>target>axis; centre = first solid else first fill (sel piece 0, refl 4) else 9.
HUD col 63: one 11->12 per effective (model-changing) action; row 63 static.
Hidden-state hypothesis not needed: model reused only on exact frame continuity, 29/29 stateless too.
